research.title: Context Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing passage ordering and relevance filtering while holding the retriever, generator, and evaluation questions fixed.
Analyzed answer correctness and supporting evidence across context conditions, categorizing errors associated with distractor passages and missing information.

research.title: Negation Sensitivity in Sentiment Classification
bullets: Designed paired sentence evaluations to test sentiment classifiers under negation insertion, scope changes, and contrastive clause constructions.
Analyzed prediction changes across lexical and transformer baselines, separating failures in negation handling from sensitivity to unrelated wording.

research.title: Intent Classification Under Class Imbalance and Domain Shift
bullets: Designed experiments comparing class weighting and resampling for support request classification, using held-out domains to examine generalization.
Analyzed per-class recall, calibration, and confusion patterns to distinguish minority intent errors from domain-specific vocabulary effects.

publications.title: Class Weighting and Resampling for Support Request Intent Classification Across Domains

work.title: Document Processing Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented document validation and text normalization components for an ingestion service, including explicit handling of malformed inputs and duplicate submissions.
Maintained regression tests, investigated processing failures from service logs, and updated error handling to support recoverable ingestion failures.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Named Entity Taggers
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field tagger and fine-tuned a transformer baseline using consistent tokenization alignment and dataset splits.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, inspecting boundary errors, rare entity categories, and predictions involving previously unseen surface forms.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented term-weighted and dense embedding retrieval pipelines over a shared document collection, keeping query sets and relevance judgments consistent.
Compared ranking quality and query latency, examining retrieval failures involving vocabulary mismatch, ambiguous queries, and semantically related distractors.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented graph-based and centroid-based sentence ranking methods for extractive summarization, applying a shared preprocessing pipeline and summary length constraint.
Compared summaries using overlap metrics and manual content checks, documenting redundancy, missing central claims, and disrupted referential coherence.
